name: drupal-contrib-skills
description: Comprehensive suite of AI agent skills for Drupal Core, Contrib modules, themes, recipes, issue handling, testing, security, and project governance.

plugins.name: drupal-core-issue
plugins.description: Resolve and review Drupal Core issues, work with issue forks, run DDEV/PHPUnit tests, Conventional Commits with By: trailers, and format drupal.org issue comments.

plugins.name: drupal-contrib-issue
plugins.description: Contribute to Drupal contrib modules and themes across both traditional drupal.org issue queues and modern native GitLab issues.

plugins.name: drupal-standards
plugins.description: Enforce Drupal coding standards (PHPCS Drupal/DrupalPractice), PHPStan static analysis, PHP 8 #[Hook] and plugin attributes, and strict config schemas.

plugins.name: drupal-patch-reroll
plugins.description: Audit, fix, and reroll Drupal composer patches (v1 & v2), discover GitLab MR diffs, and resolve reject files.

plugins.name: drupal-new-project
plugins.description: Scaffold and launch new Drupal modules, themes, starterkits, and recipes adhering to Drupal.org naming rules, mandatory files, and Git branches.

plugins.name: drupal-security-optin
plugins.description: Audit code for SQLi, XSS, CSRF, and accessCheck requirements to pass the Drupal.org Security Advisory (SA) Coverage review.

plugins.name: drupal-release-management
plugins.description: Manage semantic versioning releases, release branches, Git tags, release notes, and coordinated Security Advisory releases.

plugins.name: drupal-project-governance
plugins.description: Manage project governance, claim abandoned projects via the 14-day queue process, onboard co-maintainers, and migrate to GitLab issues.

plugins.name: drupal-gitlab-ci
plugins.description: Configure, debug, and customize official Drupal Association GitLab CI/CD pipelines (.gitlab-ci.yml), test matrices, and linters.

plugins.name: drupal-recipe-authoring
plugins.description: Author, test, and package Drupal Recipes (recipe.yml) using the Config Actions API, module dependencies, and demo content.

plugins.name: drupal-skills-updater
plugins.description: Audit, synchronize, and maintain this skill collection against Drupal Core changes, Change Records, and GitLab CI updates.
